what: What tt-train's MoE support can and cannot do on this box, measured on tt-metal v0.77.0
why: The MoE arch question was open: if tt-tnt grows a sparse-MoE variant, what can this hardware actually train? Sparse MoE training landed in tt-train as #43508 (c3a3b4e508) and is available for the first time today.
hardware: 2 chips of one P300 board (lease-granted; a 1-chip request expands to the board)

results.reading: Sparse MoE training ops run here. This is the path a tt-tnt MoE variant would use.

results.reason: Expert parallelism wants a 32-node mesh. The fabric topology mapper refuses explicitly: 'target graph is larger with 32 nodes, but global graph only has 2 nodes'.
results.reading: Expert-parallel MoE is out of reach on a single P300 board. Not a bug, a size requirement.

consequence_for_tt_tnt.viable_here: A sparse MoE variant trained WITHOUT expert parallelism -- experts sharded within the 2 chips we have.
consequence_for_tt_tnt.not_viable_here: Anything relying on EP across a large mesh. Those configs (deepseek_16B_8chip_ep.yaml, deepseek_16B_32chip_ep.yaml) are for hardware we do not have.
consequence_for_tt_tnt.starting_config: tt-train/configs/training_configs/tiny_deepseek_single_sparse_ep.yaml is the small one; tiny_deepseek_single_dense.yaml is its dense control.
consequence_for_tt_tnt.and_the_serving_constraint_still_applies: Whatever kv head count an MoE variant uses must be divisible by 2 (and by 4 for P300_X2), or it cannot be served on this hardware at all -- see serving-on-v077.json. kv=3 is already a dead end for the 384 model.

not_claimed: No MoE model was trained. This measures only that the ops and their tests run, and where the size ceiling is.
